weakest_scene.root_cause: The relative-risk claim (about 200% more likely obesity) fell back to a generic two-bar comparison with auto-placed long labels that collide. No subject form was drawn and the mascot was given no causal act.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Show obesity risk physically: e.g. two populations, one with a wide spread of walkers and one even, with the high-inequality side's risk load visibly about 3x heavier. Use one short readable label per side ("Unequal (US)" / "Equal (Japan)"), one headline number ("~3x"), and have Data add the weight that makes the gap grow.
